stories.h: Soggy, gusty week ahead; king tides threaten coastal flooding
stories.s: Monday brings steadier rain and 30 mph breezes, then a stronger Tuesday front could drop nearly 2 inches on the coast. A supermoon king tide plus low pressure may flood low-lying shorelines Tuesday through Friday, peaking Wednesday.

stories.h: Tides cancel Port Townsend sailings; Kitsap fast ferry trims trips
stories.s: WSF canceled Monday evening Port Townsend/Coupeville sailings because of tides, pointing riders to Edmonds/Kingston or Mukilteo/Clinton. Kitsap Transit cut 10 daily Bremerton-Seattle fast-ferry runs through Dec. 1 for vessel repairs.

stories.h: Cascade passes may get snow Tuesday; gas still pricey
stories.s: Forecasters expect up to 6 inches at Stevens Pass and 3 at Snoqualmie on Tuesday, with lighter snow after. Washington's average gas price was $4.71, though Spokane's has fallen to $4.24.

stories.h: Lawyer: Sea-Tac ICE detainees have pending asylum, no record
stories.s: An attorney for the couple arrested on a Sea-Tac jet bridge says they entered legally in 2015, have pending immigration cases and no criminal history. ICE alleges the woman threw coffee at officers; both remain held in Tacoma.

stories.h: Alaska Airlines machinists picket at Sea-Tac and headquarters today
stories.s: Workers represented by IAM Local 2202 planned a Monday picket and rally pressing for job security and a fair contract. The union has not said whether flights would be affected.

talking.h: Huskies stun No. 6 Indiana 27-24 in overtime
talking.s: UW beat the defending national champions after Indiana missed an OT field goal, and fans stormed the field at Husky Stadium. Washington is 7-4 and heads to No. 14 Oregon Saturday.
Washington State scored first but lost big in San Marcos. The Cougars host a Pac-12-assigned opponent, still to be announced, on Saturday.

coming.h: Stormy Tuesday: gusty rain, pass snow
coming.s: A stronger front brings gusty rain to the lowlands and up to 6 inches of snow at Stevens Pass. Check WSDOT pass reports before crossing.

coming.h: King tide peak; coastal flooding risk
coming.s: Minor coastal flooding is possible Tuesday through Friday, worst Wednesday. Steer clear of low-lying shoreline parks, roads and beaches.
WSF expects heavy traffic Nov. 25-29, with westbound peaks Thursday-Friday and eastbound Saturday-Sunday. Several routes run holiday schedules; reserve where possible.

coming.h: Thanksgiving tolls: weekend rates, free express lanes
coming.s: Weekend toll rates apply on SR 520, the SR 99 tunnel and SR 509 on Thursday. The I-405 and SR 167 express toll lanes are free for everyone that day.
Fresh off the Indiana upset, UW visits rival Oregon in the regular-season finale.
The 6-4 Seahawks play at San Francisco's Levi's Stadium, 1:25 p.m. kickoff.
